title: scheduled_event — FUTURE dated event emitted by causal propagation (living world)
description: A 'scheduled' event is a FUTURE and DETERMINISTIC trace (who/what/when) written by causal_propagate.py / world_tick.py into scheduled_events.json (contract §8.3, doc 04 §3). Its topology (target) and timing (T = T_cause + delay_ut) are computed by graph traversal; its NARRATIVE QUALIFICATION ('narratif') is DEFERRED to an LLM seam, filled only at resolution and only if observable by the PC (lazy generation). This schema validates TWO forms: (a) an ISOLATED event; (b) the FILE scheduled_events.json {meta, events:[...]} (SEPARATE file, non-destructive: NEVER merge into events.json without GM decision). Tolerant (additionalProperties:true).

fichier.description: Container for scheduled_events.json: meta + list of scheduled/resolved events.

note.description: Warning: SEPARATE file, NEVER merge into events.json without GM decision.

events.description: Scheduled (future) or resolved (reached by tick) events.

event.description: Isolated scheduled event (contract §8.3). id 'evt:<type>-<T>' unique (T zero-padded for uniqueness). T is a FUTURE instant in UT (never earlier than the cause).

T.description: Scheduled instant in UT (1 UT = 10 min, T=0 at creation). ALWAYS future: T >= T of cause.

type.description: Type of propagated effect (e.g., 'raid', 'shortage', 'distress_call', 'local_pressure', 'migration', 'migrant_departure', 'fortification', 'requisition'). Campaign-extensible enum.

cible.description: id of the location OR actor affected by the effect (e.g., 'lieu:market-of-three-rivers/berthe-cottage', 'faction:silver-bank-counts').

actor.description: id of the actor originating the effect, or null if unattributable. Optional.

cause.description: id of the causal event or intention (cascade chaining; allows tracing back to the root).

significativite.description: 0–1: STRICTLY decreases with each hop (× weight × ATTENUATION). Below THRESHOLD, the wave extinguishes (anti-cycle, guaranteed termination).

statut.description: Lifecycle: 'programme' (future, not yet arrived) | 'resolu' (reached by tick) | 'annule'.

profondeur.description: Depth in the cascade (0 = root). Bounded by PROFONDEUR_MAX. Optional (audit trail).

label.description: Short readable title (e.g., 'Raven Band Supply Raid'). null until qualified. Optional.

consequence_attendue.description: Expected narrative effect (text). null until qualified (deferred to LLM seam). Optional.

visible_par_pj.description: Is the event observable by the PC? Conditions deferred narrative qualification. Optional.

narratif.description: DEFERRED LLM qualification: null until resolved/unobservable; filled at resolution if observable (lazy generation, doc 04 §2). DO NOT compute here.
